method: Kanban: Spec -> Build -> parallel Review -> batched Owner decision. Map reviewer botId and strong/small models to available engine choices before enabling. Repeat this process per design, asset or runtime scope; preserve existing approval dependencies.

steps.title: Spec: plan
steps.instruction: Freeze the input revision and acceptance. Write an exact plan with dependencies, allowed write paths, evidence and reviewer roles. Address feedback. Do not edit production files yet.

steps.title: Spec: independent plan score
steps.instruction: Independently check the plan against the request. Return FAIL if any acceptance, input, ownership or required approval is missing. PASS requires score >=90 and no veto; include vetoes in notes.
steps.criteria: PASS only with score >=90 and no veto.

steps.title: Build and self-check
steps.instruction: Implement only the approved plan within its write scope, apply feedback, run focused checks and freeze an output revision/hash. Include evidence and remaining risks.

steps.title: Visual review
steps.instruction: Independently review visual fidelity and required assets on the exact frozen build revision. Return structured verdict, severity, evidence and revision in notes. Mark N/A only with a scoped reason. Do not modify source.

steps.title: Interaction review
steps.instruction: Independently review main/error/back/cancel flows and real input evidence on the exact frozen build revision. Return structured verdict, severity, evidence and revision in notes. Mark N/A only with a scoped reason. Do not modify source.

steps.title: Code review
steps.instruction: Independently review correctness, safety, tests and compatibility on the exact frozen build revision. Return structured verdict, severity, evidence and revision in notes. Mark N/A only with a scoped reason. Do not modify source.

steps.title: Review: aggregate
steps.instruction: Aggregate every required review of the same revision. A critical veto or missing acceptance evidence is FAIL regardless of vote count. Record non-blocking minor findings as follow-ups with owners. Return structured verdict and actionable feedback.
steps.criteria: PASS only when all required acceptance is met, with no critical veto or mixed revisions.

steps.title: Owner: decision batch
steps.instruction: Review this exact candidate, its evidence and the batched decisions. Approve promotion of this scope?

steps.title: Deliver approved scope
steps.instruction: Report the approved artifact/hash, actual checks, owner decision and follow-ups. Claim only this accepted scope; record Kanban DONE only if its DoD is met.

steps.title: Escalate or wait
steps.instruction: Report the failed or rejected condition, evidence, exhausted attempts and exact next owner/action. Keep the scope WAITING or BLOCKED as appropriate; do not claim delivery or approval.
